tools.name: agentcheck_create_target
tools.description: Enroll something to monitor: an http endpoint (JSON or OpenAI-style chat), a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP url) or an A2A agent (origin with /.well-known/agent-card.json). Pass `checks` to create checks in the same call (POST /api/v1/probe proposes three). Returns the target id, the public stat

tools.description: Add a check to one of your targets. A check runs an input (http path/prompt, mcp tool call, a2a message) on a schedule and judges the answer with a golden: exact, contains, regex and json_schema cost nothing; rubric and baseline use the LLM judge (baseline = same outcome as the last known-good answe

tools.name: agentcheck_run_now
tools.description: Run every check of one of your targets immediately (outside the schedule) and return pass/fail per check with latency, judge cost and any incident opened or closed. Use it right after enrolling, or to confirm a fix. Requires an API key.

tools.name: agentcheck_record
tools.description: Record one production interaction with your agent (the prompt or messages, the final answer, the tools it called, optionally the model) as a trace on a target. Call it from your agent or from a proxy in front of it after each task; promote a good trace with agentcheck_promote_trace to replay it nigh

tools.name: agentcheck_promote_trace
tools.description: Turn an imported or recorded trace into a replayable check whose golden is the recorded outcome (tool sequence + final-answer rubric). The check runs daily and in the nightly replay (Pro). Returns the check. Requires an API key.

tools.name: agentcheck_list_incidents
tools.description: Open and recent incidents across your targets (or one target): when they opened/closed, the failing check and the cause. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentcheck_get_status, agentcheck_model_retirements, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_add_check · Private data: agentcheck_get_status, agentcheck_get_pricing, agentcheck_model_retirements, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_add_check, agentcheck_run_now, agentcheck_record, agentcheck_promote_trace, agentcheck_list_incidents · Public sink: agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target · Destructive: agentcheck_get_pricing, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_run_now.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentcheck_get_status, agentcheck_model_retirements, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_add_check · Private data: agentcheck_get_status, agentcheck_get_pricing, agentcheck_model_retirements, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_add_check, agentcheck_run_now, agentcheck_record, agentcheck_promote_trace, agentcheck_list_incidents · Public sink: agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_statuspage_preview, agentcheck_create_target · Destructive: agentcheck_get_pricing, agentcheck_api_sunsets, agentcheck_create_target, agentcheck_run_now

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "agentcheck_create_target" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
